title: Eric Clapton moves from minor to major in Key to the Highway
seoTitle: Eric Clapton Key to the Highway Solo: Minor to Major | Gametape Licks
summary: A 24 Nights blues solo where Clapton shifts between minor and major color one phrase at a time.
description: Watch Eric Clapton play Key to the Highway from his 24 Nights run at Royal Albert Hall and hear him move between minor and major pentatonic. Includes a listening guide.
intro: In 1990 and 1991 Clapton played 24 nights at the Royal Albert Hall, and the blues nights gave him a band built to follow him. This Key to the Highway stayed in the vault until Warner released it in 2023.
A relaxed blues shows the switch from lesson 3 clearly. He sets up the minor pentatonic, lets a phrase hang, then opens a door to the major sound by bending toward the 3rd or sliding into it.
Listen to how each major phrase arrives. It follows a minor phrase and answers it. Play along with the lesson open and try making the same turn yourself.
